title: Product Management | Marketing Operations | Adobe Workfront Strategy
headline: Product-minded marketing operations leader specializing in Adobe Workfront, workflow strategy, and AI-enabled transformation. Experienced translating complex business challenges into scalable operating models, governance frameworks, integrations, and product roadmaps that improve execution, adoption, and business outcomes. Known for aligning stakeholders, defining priorities, and building systems that simplify how work gets planned, managed, and delivered.
profileTitle: Product and operations leader with 24 years of experience designing scalable workflow ecosystems for creative and marketing organizations.
profile: Proven ability to partner with stakeholders, identify operational challenges, define strategic roadmaps, and deliver enterprise solutions that improve planning, governance, resourcing, execution, and reporting. Combines hands-on platform expertise with a consultative approach to guide teams through change, drive adoption, and balance immediate business needs against long-term scalability.
productLeadership: Own Adobe Workfront strategy and governance for agency operations supporting marketing, creative, and business stakeholders.

Partner with divisional leaders, administrators, and technology teams to evaluate enhancement requests, prioritize platform investments, and balance short-term business needs against long-term scalability.
Define standards for intake, workflows, metadata, templates, reporting, and automation to improve consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Lead discovery sessions with stakeholders to translate business challenges into scalable platform capabilities, governance models, and roadmap initiatives.
Drive adoption through training programs, office hours, documentation, and change management efforts that increase platform engagement and workflow compliance.

bullets: Optimized Adobe Workfront workflows, reducing time-to-market by 23% through process redesign, automation, and platform optimization.
